slot_note: seed ET28 (which routes are overpriced: airfares from the 10% ticket sample without double counting round trips); the world (an air service development team pitching three routes a year to airlines), the decision (which three city pairs) and the quantity (how many local travellers fly each market, and what they pay) kept; the pitfall re-found in how the hub's parking card survey gets its replies back
niche: a state aviation bureau's 2027 route pitch for its regional airport, ranked on the 2026 passengers from the regional service area who drove to the state's hub airport and parked there, estimated from the hub's parking entry register and a card survey whose cards come back only when the car leaves
stakeholder_role: the bureau's air service development manager

spine.file: Ardmoor parking card survey returns, 2026 waves
spine.entity: one returned survey card: one car's parked trip at the hub, with the travel party's home ZIP, final destination, nights away and party size
spine.source: synthetic (constructed in the layout of an airport parking customer card survey keyed from paper)

world.geography: United States, an unnamed state (the bureau, its two airports, the survey contractor and the people are fictional; the destination airports and the ticket sample's record layout are real)
world.org_type: state aviation bureau that owns and operates a hub airport and a regional airport

driver: The decisive quantity is a per-category total of trips taken from replies to a sample handed out on each day of a fixed window, where a reply comes back only when its trip ends and collection stopped soon after the window closed, so a long trip is among the replies only if it began early enough to end before collection stopped; the categories made of long trips are restored by weighting each reply by the inverse of the share of handout days from which a trip of its length could have come back, not by the return rate of its own handout day nor by the inverse of its length.
driver_concrete: Each candidate market's 2026 service-area passengers parked at Ardmoor are each wave's quarter of parking entries times the market's share of the wave's returned cards, each card weighted by the inverse of the share of the wave's handed cards whose handout day left room for a stay of its nights to end by the last box collection, not raw card shares, nor each handout day's return rate, nor one over nights.
stump: The default path expands each wave's returned cards to its quarter's parking entries and pitches Orlando, New York and Washington, because the cards handed out in each wave's last weeks came back only from short trips, so the two- to four-week stays that make up much of Fort Myers and Tampa are missing from the replies; weighted for when each stay could have come back, Fort Myers and Tampa rank second and third.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who keys every destination to its city market, keeps the service-area ZIPs, counts each party's passengers and expands each wave's returned cards to its quarter's parking entries, or reweights them by each handout day's return rate, pitches Orlando, New York and Washington; only weighting each card by the inverse of the share of handout days from which a stay of its length could have been collected pitches Orlando, Fort Myers and Tampa.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a register-based total completed by a supplement survey: the hub's parking entry register counts each quarter's parked trips and the card survey supplies destination, home and party, and survey research's design-based estimator weights each returned card by the inverse of its chance of having been collected, which the fieldwork design sets from the card's handout day and the stay's length; swapped for a share of the replies, the generic estimator of another field, the long stays drop out and the call changes, and without a register, a card that exists only once the stay ends and a collection close the task has nothing to estimate.
layer1: card survey keyed from paper: destinations as written (city names, airport codes, resort and region names), ZIPs with and without leading zeros or a plus-four, nights written as words
handout log by wave and day giving the card serial ranges handed, apart from the cards themselves
parking revenue system daily entry counts by lot in quarterly extracts whose lot names and layout change mid-year
service-area ZIP list built from county lists, one ZIP straddling two counties
airport codes rolled up to city markets (Washington, New York, Chicago and others spanning several airports)
the regional airport's 2027 schedule naming the markets already served nonstop
the 10% airline ticket sample's quarterly market and ticket files, round-trip itinerary fares beside prorated market fares
